Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 19669 Act Number: 9 Enactment Date: 1966-05-13 Act Year: 1966 Short Title: The Telangana Official Languages Act, 1966. Long Title: An Act to provide, for the adoption of the Telugu language as the language to be used for the official purposes of the State of Telangana and for the transaction of business in the State Legislature, for the use of any other language also for any of the aforesaid purposes, and for matters connected therewith.
